decisions.reason: Product A builds on the firm's established compact dumper expertise, so the firm can interpret early results and improve it.
Product B builds on the firm's established construction dumper knowledge, enabling learning and refinement.
Product C is distant from the firm's established equipment and engineering base, making it hard to interpret early results or learn from them despite in-house R&D.
Product D extends the firm's existing loader and construction equipment capabilities, so the firm can leverage its knowledge across several models.
